dct_description_sm: Increased stormwater due to climate change is already having a serious impact in the Breton Regional Municipality in which Membertou. Severe weather events such as compressed precipitation events whereby large amounts of rainfall fall faster than groundwater absorption rates, high winds, infiltration issues from increasing storm frequency and severity will all contribute and increase risks from stormwater for the community. The objectives of this project are to: (1) complete a stormwater adaptation management plan for Membertou First Nation; (2) complete a water harvesting adaptation plan for Potlotek First Nation; and (3) develop an adaptation development guidelines document for Malikewe'j.
